name: oddeyes-desktop
description: Connect Claude Desktop to a running OddEyes app and send preview-first translation actions.
long_description: OddEyes Desktop lets Claude Desktop read the source document, target document, and translation context from the currently running OddEyes app. Translation output is sent to OddEyes as a preview first, so users can review and explicitly apply or discard it inside OddEyes.

tools.name: oddeyes_get_status
tools.description: Get the current OddEyes project status and active source/target revisions.

tools.name: oddeyes_get_source_document
tools.description: Read the current source document from OddEyes.

tools.name: oddeyes_get_target_document
tools.description: Read the current target document from OddEyes.

tools.name: oddeyes_get_translation_context
tools.description: Read translation rules, glossary, and project context from OddEyes.

tools.name: oddeyes_get_translation_preview
tools.description: Read the current preview that is waiting in OddEyes.

tools.name: oddeyes_set_translation_preview
tools.description: Create or replace an OddEyes translation preview without applying it.

tools.name: oddeyes_apply_translation_preview
tools.description: Apply the current OddEyes translation preview to the target document.

tools.name: oddeyes_discard_translation_preview
tools.description: Discard the current OddEyes translation preview.

tools.name: oddeyes_set_review_issues
tools.description: Push an external translation review (issue list) into the OddEyes review panel and highlight matched spans in the editor.

tools.name: oddeyes_set_translation_context
tools.description: Update OddEyes translation rules and/or project context (replace or append).

tools.name: oddeyes_log_quality_records
tools.description: Append quality-ledger records (findings/fixes/verdicts, including rejected ones) to the OddEyes SQLite ledger.

tools.name: oddeyes_get_quality_records
tools.description: Query the OddEyes quality ledger with filters (since, stage, disposition, promotionStatus, limit) for mining.

tools.name: oddeyes_list_project_glossaries
tools.description: List glossaries linked to the active OddEyes project and the full glossary library.

tools.name: oddeyes_list_glossary_entries
tools.description: List entries in a glossary (optional query; default limit 100, max 500).

tools.name: oddeyes_add_glossary_entry
tools.description: Add a glossary term to the active OddEyes project (auto-links glossary when needed).

tools.name: oddeyes_update_glossary_entry
tools.description: Update an existing glossary entry (source, target, notes).

tools.name: oddeyes_delete_glossary_entry
tools.description: Permanently delete a glossary entry (no undo).

tools.name: oddeyes_link_project_glossary
tools.description: Link a library glossary to the active project (incremental, idempotent).

tools.name: oddeyes_unlink_project_glossary
tools.description: Unlink a glossary from the active project without deleting the library glossary.
